alt.en: A panoramic view of brick campus buildings, bare trees and stone steps beneath a blue sky.
alt.zh: 蓝天下的校园全景，红砖建筑、落叶树和石阶。

alt.en: A redbrick building beside a pine tree, with the city visible in the distance.
alt.zh: 松树旁的红砖建筑，远处可以看到城市。

caption.en: When the street lights come on

alt.en: A town street at twilight, with a church steeple, glowing lamps and traffic light trails under a purple sky.
alt.zh: 紫色暮光中的街道，教堂尖塔、亮起的街灯和车流光轨。

caption.en: The last light of the day

alt.en: Brick campus buildings on a sloping lawn beneath a warm sunset sky.
alt.zh: 暖色夕阳下，草坡上的校园红砖建筑。

alt.en: A stone bench and grass beneath trees at sunset, with a glimpse of the city beyond.
alt.zh: 日落时树下的石凳与草地，远处露出城市的一角。

alt.en: The setting sun shining through foliage above a wide view of the city.
alt.zh: 夕阳穿过树叶，下方是开阔的城市景色。

alt.en: A squirrel resting on a bare branch beside a large tree trunk.
alt.zh: 一只松鼠停在粗大树干旁的光秃树枝上。

alt.en: Pale spring blossoms covering interwoven branches, with green foliage behind them.
alt.zh: 交错枝条上开满浅色花朵，后方是绿色树叶。

alt.en: A vertical view down a wet city street lined with tall brick buildings, cars and a glowing horizon.
alt.zh: 竖幅城市街景，湿润路面、车辆和两侧高耸的砖楼，远处天际泛着亮光。
